meta.aciklama: Four games with law cards, spaced repetition, HMGS subject decks and a 120 question mock exam. Every card is tied to a primary legislation source.
meta.hmgsBaslik: HMGS: subject decks and mock exam
meta.hmgsAciklama: 20 subject decks for the Legal Professions Entrance Exam, a 120 question and 155 minute mock exam, a pass mark 70 simulation and a subject report.

giris: Play four short games with law cards, and the cards you forget come back at the right time.
kaynakNotu: Every card is tied to an article of a law; after the answer you see the article number, a word for word quotation from the law and the source. Cards are educational content, not legal advice.
cihazNotu: Your progress, settings and exam results are stored only in this device's browser; nothing is sent to the server.

onizleme.metin: In this environment cards waiting for editor approval are visible too. Cards that are not approved are not published.

bos.metin: Before a card is published it is compared word for word with its source and approved by lawyer editors; two different editors approve each HMGS card. {bekleyen} cards are waiting for editor approval right now.
bos.hmgsMetin: The mock exam is built from published cards. The exam is not open yet because no card is published.

bugun.yeniBekleyen: New cards waiting for the daily limit
bugun.hicYok: No reviews or new cards today. Look again tomorrow.

ayar.yeniKartIpucu: Reviews are not limited by this number; only cards you see for the first time count.
ayar.hedefIpucu: The default is 90 percent. A higher value brings cards back more often, a lower value less often.

olayKarti.yonerge: Read the case and choose the provision that applies.

halaGecerliMi.kisa: Is the provision valid today, changed, or no longer in force?
halaGecerliMi.yonerge: Choose the current status of the provision below.

dogruYanlis.yonerge: Is the statement true or false?

hangisiOnce.yonerge: Which of the two came first?

oyunlar.kartYok: No published card for this game.
oyunlar.nasil: Games open inside a deck: choose a deck below. Each game is a short round of at most ten cards; at the end of a round you can retry your wrong answers.

desteler.aciklama: Every HMGS subject has its own deck. The weight of a subject follows the OSYM distribution.
desteler.tabloAciklama: 20 subjects with the share of each in the exam, the number of mock exam questions and the card status.

deste.calisKisa: Study the cards that are due and the new cards of the day.
deste.yanlislarimKisa: Try again the cards whose last answer was wrong.
deste.yanlisYok: No card with a wrong answer.
deste.kartYok: No published card in this deck.
deste.bekleyenNot: {sayi} cards in this deck are waiting for editor approval.

tur.secenekIpucu: Choose options with Tab and Enter, or with the keys 1 to {son}.

geri.dogrulama: The quotation was compared word for word with the source page: {tarih}

calisma.bittiMetin: No more cards are due today and no new cards are available. Cards you answered wrongly come back tomorrow.
calisma.yanlisNot: A wrongly answered card is rescheduled for at least one day later and is also asked once more in this session.

hmgs.giris: 20 subject decks, a 120 question and 155 minute mock exam, a pass mark 70 simulation and a subject report.

sinav.madde2: Only correct answers earn points, out of 100. A wrong answer does not lower the score.
sinav.madde3: The pass mark is 70: you need 84 of the 120 questions right.
sinav.madde4: The distribution follows the subject shares of the OSYM 2026 Application Guide. The 2027 exam dates are verified from the OSYM calendar; no guess is written here.
sinav.ozgun: The questions are original: OSYM questions are not copied or adapted.

hmgs.denemeKapali: The mock exam is not open yet

kismi.metin: A full mock exam needs enough approved questions in every subject; there are {mevcut} questions now. This exam is built in the proportions of the OSYM shares among the subjects that have questions, as {soru} questions and {sure} minutes. Score and pass mark are scaled to this number of questions; it does not replace the real exam.
kismi.eksik: Subjects missing for a full exam: {konular}

hmgs.havuz: Published questions that fit the mock exam: {sayi}
hmgs.secenekNotu: The mock exam is built only from cards with four or five choices; the real exam has five choices.

rapor.aciklama: The share of correct answers in your completed exams, starting from the weakest subject.
rapor.yok: No completed exam yet. After the first exam the subject report appears here.

deneme.hazirMetin: The clock does not stop once it starts. If you refresh or close and reopen the page the exam continues where you left it and the time keeps running.
deneme.sureBitti: Time is up. The exam has ended.
deneme.bitirOnay: Are you sure you want to finish the exam? {bos} unanswered questions count as blank.
deneme.paletAciklama: Choose a number to go to that question. Answered and marked questions are described in text.

sonuc.barajGecti: Above the pass mark: 70 points or more.
sonuc.barajKaldi: Below the pass mark: under 70 points.
sonuc.barajNot: The pass mark simulation is calculated for the number of questions of this exam.
sonuc.olcekNot: Partial exam: the score is scaled to {soru} questions.
sonuc.tekrarNot: {sayi} wrong or blank cards were added to your repeat deck; they come back in tomorrow's spaced repetition session.
sonuc.tekrarYok: You have no wrong or blank questions.

deneme.kayitHatasi: The exam could not be stored in your browser; you can see the result on this screen but it will not be saved.

editor.giris: Cards that are not published. A card is published only after its source was compared word for word and it has the editor approvals it needs: two different editors for HMGS cards, one for the others. The author of a card cannot approve it; when the question, the answer or the source changes, the old approvals stop counting.
editor.yetkiYok: This page is for lawyer editors. You have no session or no editor role.
editor.nasilMetin: An approval is added to the content file as a record and reviewed in a pull request. To see the queue run node content/desteler/onayla.ts --liste, to approve run node content/desteler/onayla.ts --kart <card id> --editor "Full Name". To compare the source again use node content/desteler/dogrula.ts.
editor.bosKuyruk: No card is waiting for approval.
